title: Whole-adapter process resource evidence (legacy)
description: Normalized CPU, memory, fault, and context-switch evidence for one whole adapter process including warmup, produced by readProcessResources in legacy/benchctl/process-resources.mjs from the raw /usr/bin/time output captured by scripts/measure-benchmark-process. Consumed by legacy/benchctl/fixed-seal.mjs, fixed-suite.mjs, and reference-probe-seal.mjs. Descriptive documentation of migrated behavior, not a gate.

method.description: Which raw resource-meter dialect was parsed. Selected by the presence of the GNU maximum-resident-set-size line.

peak_memory_bytes.description: Darwin peak physical footprint, or the GNU maximum resident set size on Linux. Both adapters in a comparison must use the same peak_memory_method.

instructions_retired.description: Darwin-only counter; null when the host or dialect does not expose it.

cycles_elapsed.description: Darwin-only counter; null when the host or dialect does not expose it.
